name: codex-capability-profiler
description: Generate a private, evidence-labeled report of capability signals in local Codex task history or a supplied task export.

interface.longDescription: Create a local HTML, Markdown, and JSON report from Codex task history or a supplied task export. Inspect ten heuristic capability areas, archived tasks, classification gaps, and source coverage. Task titles are used by default; request context is opt-in. Generate a separate redacted export for review before sharing. Requires Node.js 22 or later; SQLite is optional for local database access. Local state is not a stable API, and cloud conversations absent from it are outside scope. These are workflow signals, not billing metrics or a standardized expertise benchmark.
defaultPrompt: Profile my local Codex capability maturity.
Audit whether every local Codex task is included.
